title: Register Risk
statement: Implement `solve(has_send)`. ABC.register can mark a class as a virtual subclass without checking methods. Return `risk` when `has_send` is 0, because the class would pass an isinstance check and fail when send is called. Return `ok` when `has_send` is 1.
constraints: register does not prove the methods exist
hints: The flag is the only evidence you have.
Present send is ok, even though register itself did not check.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: register updates the abstract class's virtual subclass registry.

editorial: register updates the abstract class's virtual subclass registry. isinstance becomes true. The call still fails if send is absent. That is the risk. A real subclass declaration runs the abstract-method check at construction. register skips it.
reference_solution:
def solve(has_send):
    return "ok" if has_send else "risk"
